description.en:
The type of the client.

Valid values:

*   1: hardware client.
*   2: software client.
The IDs of the devices. You can specify up to 200 IDs.

description.zh: 当设备已有绑定的终端用户时，是否强制删除该设备。
description.en:
Specifies whether to forcefully delete the device if the device is bound to a user.

Valid values:

*   0: do not forcefully delete the device.
*   1: forcefully delete the device.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the regions supported by WUYING Workspace.

descriptions.en: You can call the operation to manage client devices.
